title: NF Research Tools - Computational Tool

containerized.description: Whether containerized versions (Docker, Singularity) are available.

dateAdded.description: The date that the resource was originally added.

dateModified.description: The last update of the resource metadata.

description.description: Free text description, summary, or purpose of the resource.

documentation.description: URL to documentation or user manual.

howToAcquire.description: How to acquire a particular resource.

lastUpdate.description: Date of last software update or release.

maintainer.description: Name or organization maintaining the software.

resourceId.description: A unique identifier for the resource.

resourceName.description: The canonical name of the resource.

rrid.description: The RRID, a standard resource identifier for interoperability with other databases. Must include the lowercase 'rrid:' prefix.

softwareName.description: The name of the software or computational tool.

sourceRepository.description: URL to source code repository (e.g. GitHub, GitLab).
